description: This file is a Python script that defines classes and functions for generating test suite code for a project named 'clar'. It includes classes for handling modules, templates, and test suites, with functionality for parsing test functions, managing cache, and writing output files.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a module with associated callbacks, initializers, and cleanup, capable of parsing test functions from source code and rendering code templates.

classes.name: TestSuite
classes.description: Manages a collection of modules, handles caching, and generates the 'clar.suite' output file based on the modules and their test functions.

methods.name: Module.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Module instance with a name.

methods.name: Module.clean_name
methods.description: Converts the module name by replacing underscores with double colons.

methods.name: Module._skip_comments
methods.description: Removes comments from source code text.

methods.name: Module.parse
methods.description: Parses source code contents to find test functions, callbacks, initializers, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: Module.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes module data from a file, checking modification time and re-parsing if needed.

methods.name: TestSuite.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a TestSuite with a path and output directory.

methods.name: TestSuite.should_generate
methods.description: Determines if the output file should be generated based on module modifications.

methods.name: TestSuite.find_modules
methods.description: Finds and returns modules (source files) in the specified path.

methods.name: TestSuite.load_cache
methods.description: Loads cached module data from a pickle file.

methods.name: TestSuite.save_cache
methods.description: Saves current module data to cache.

methods.name: TestSuite.load
methods.description: Loads modules, optionally forcing reload, and refreshes their data.

methods.name: TestSuite.disable
methods.description: Disables modules whose names start with specified prefixes.

methods.name: TestSuite.suite_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of test suites.

methods.name: TestSuite.callback_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of callbacks.

methods.name: TestSuite.write
methods.description: Generates the 'clar.suite' output file if needed, writing module declarations, callbacks, and suite info.
